title: Where did you go?
author: Anonymous Witness
text: Where did u go? Its been over a month and no updates :(
response:
So sorry for being gone for so long.
I love sharing these secret behind the scenes with ya'll.
Life has just gotten very crazy.
I am not even responding to most comments and DMs on social media now.
Trying to build a team, finish songs, and make vids while traveling is just so much to do haha.
Have been behind for a long time on everything.
That is why I have remade this secret page so things can be uploaded one by one instead of a whole page refresh every week.
This way I can actually upload things as they are created and new Witnesses can see some the historical content!
Hope ya'll will keep sharing with me and I am so excited to be back :D

title: A Message for The Architect
author: Witness #12
text:
A Message for The Architect,

At the moment of sending this message, as judged by the scrawls upon the walls left by previous souls, I suspect that I am Witness #12 to earn passage beyond The Gate.
I have today received my reward for solving the first puzzle, which was lovely; excellent marbling in the wax seal on the envelope, by the way.
I have provided my contribution to The Woven, for such is the first step on the Path, and I hope it brings joy, curiosity, and wonder unto future Witnesses.
I await, with bated breath, future insights and discoveries from your mystical world, and perhaps the possibility to impart my own marks upon it as well.

Stay safe, stay sane, stay Abstract,

Sincerely,
Witness #12

P.S. Rest In Power, Davina LaRose.

title: Finding the Hidden Postcard
author: Anonymous Witness
text: Hi. I have followed this whole thing from the moment "raven" came out. I have loved it! I started following on tiktok then went to insta. Finally went to the website and I got stuck. Could not figure out the hidden words. Gave up. Told my husband. He looked. We figured it out, I was so happy. Bought the hidden postcard. Waited and waited and it finally turned up. Im so happy. The wax seal on the envelope!!!! This whole journey has had everything. Excited, frustration.. everything. I love what you do and I wanted to let you know that you have made me smile
response: Thank you so much for the kind words. It is so special to me to be able to share these crazy ideas with people who actually enjoy them. Means a lot.
